categories.main_business_segments: Newtechwood Corporation primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of wood-plastic composite (WPC) materials and products. Its main product lines include outdoor flooring, wall panels, and composite flooring, which are environmentally friendly plastic-wood profiles widely used in residential yards, public buildings, and landscaping. The company also produces various WPC accessories and other related products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced extrusion molding as its main production technology, supplemented by hot pressing and injection molding. It has proprietary 360-degree full-encapsulation technology that significantly enhances product durability and aesthetics. Innovations include digital color matching, online embossing, and post-processing techniques, supported by a highly automated production line with PLC-controlled manufacturing and integrated quality management systems. The company holds over 200 patents domestically and internationally.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Newtechwood serves primarily international customers, with over 97% of revenue generated from overseas markets including North America, Europe, Oceania, and Asia. Key customers include major home improvement retailers such as Home Depot and Lowe's, large e-commerce platforms like Amazon and Wayfair, and specialized distributors. The products cater to residential, commercial, municipal, and landscaping sectors, replacing traditional wood, plastic, and aluminum materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with manufacturing bases in Guangdong and Fujian provinces and has wholly-owned subsidiaries in Hong Kong and the United States. Its sales network spans over 50 countries globally, with a strong presence in North America and Europe. The company is actively expanding production capacity in Southeast Asia to mitigate trade policy risks and enhance global supply chain resilience.
categories.supply_chain_position: Newtechwood operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and processing of wood-plastic composite materials. It sources raw materials such as recycled plastics and biomass fibers directly and produces finished WPC products for sale to distributors and end customers. The company maintains control over R&D, production, and sales, with limited upstream raw material processing and downstream retailing activities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in WPC composite materials, focusing on enhancing product performance, durability, and aesthetics through proprietary full-encapsulation technology and advanced manufacturing processes. R&D priorities include automation of production, development of high-strength and fire-retardant materials, antibacterial and anti-mold formulations, and new product lines such as aluminum-plastic composite profiles. It also invests in digitalization and intelligent manufacturing to improve efficiency and product quality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of WPC products and accessories to distributors, retailers, and end customers globally. The company employs both direct sales and distribution channels, with over 90% of revenue derived from its own branded products. It also engages in ODM manufacturing but focuses on building its proprietary brand internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Newtechwood is positioned as a leading domestic innovator and brand in the global WPC industry, competing directly with international leaders such as Trex and Fiberon. While China leads in production volume, Newtechwood distinguishes itself through technology leadership, product quality, and brand recognition. The company is among the few Chinese firms with a strong independent brand competing in mature overseas markets, breaking the traditional ODM-dominated landscape.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Newtechwood reported revenues of approximately RMB 833 million, representing a 5% year-over-year growth. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 58.5 million, a decline of about 23% due to increased market expansion and logistics costs. The company’s total assets grew by 46% to RMB 1.7 billion, and net assets increased by 75% to RMB 925 million, reflecting significant capital infusion from its 2024 IPO. The company maintains a moderate profitability level with a return on equity of 7.07%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Newtechwood offers environmentally friendly, high-performance WPC products with superior durability, weather resistance, and aesthetic appeal due to its proprietary full-encapsulation technology. Its products have a lifespan of up to 25 years, significantly longer than typical WPC products. The company’s integration of recycled materials aligns with global sustainability trends, and its advanced manufacturing automation ensures consistent quality. Its strong brand presence and certifications (e.g., SCS, Singapore Green Label) further differentiate it in competitive international markets.
